mcqs.question: Which of the following lists correctly represents the general reactivity series of metals from most reactive to least reactive?

options.A: Na > K > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Cu > Ag > Au
options.B: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.C: K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.D: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > Cu > Ag > Au

mcqs.answer: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
mcqs.explanation: The correct series places the most reactive metals (K, Na, Ca, Mg, Al, Zn, Fe, Ni, Sn, Pb) above hydrogen, followed by metals that are less reactive than hydrogen (Cu, Ag, Au). Option B follows this order exactly. Option A swaps Na and K and omits hydrogen; Option C misorders Na and Ca; Option D places copper before hydrogen, which is incorrect.

mcqs.question: A strip of zinc metal is placed in an aqueous solution of copper(II) sulfate. Which of the following best describes what will happen?

options.A: No visible change; both metals remain unchanged.
options.B: Zinc dissolves, and copper metal is deposited on the zinc strip.
options.C: Copper dissolves, and zinc metal is deposited on the copper ions.
options.D: Both zinc and copper precipitate as insoluble compounds.

mcqs.answer: Zinc dissolves, and copper metal is deposited on the zinc strip.
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it can displace copper ions from CuSO₄. Zinc atoms lose electrons to become Zn²⁺, while Cu²⁺ ions gain electrons and deposit as copper metal on the zinc surface. Option A ignores reactivity, Option C reverses the direction, and Option D suggests precipitation that does not occur.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand reactions of metals with salt solutions
mcqs.question: Both iron and magnesium metals are separately added to separate test tubes containing copper(II) sulfate solution. Which statement correctly compares the two reactions?

options.A: Both iron and magnesium will displace copper from the solution.
options.B: Only iron will displace copper; magnesium will not react.
options.C: Only magnesium will displace copper; iron will not react.
options.D: Neither iron nor magnesium will displace copper.

mcqs.answer: Both iron and magnesium will displace copper from the solution.
mcqs.explanation: In the reactivity series, both Fe and Mg are placed above hydrogen and well above copper. Therefore each can donate electrons to Cu²⁺ ions, causing copper metal to precipitate and the metal to go into solution as its ion. Options B, C, and D contradict the established series.

mcqs.question: Which metal among the following will NOT be able to displace any of the metals Cu, Ag or Au from their aqueous salt solutions?
mcqs.explanation: Lead lies below hydrogen in the reactivity series, making it less reactive than Cu, Ag and Au. Consequently it cannot displace these metals from their salts. Zinc, iron and magnesium are all above hydrogen and can displace at least copper (and in some cases silver) from solutions. Hence option C is correct.
